iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 50. MIXED: Eslami continues ruling out enrichment restrictions (repeated Apr 9). Arms Control Org confirms no evidence of resumed enrichment. Iran says peace talks 'unreasonable' after Israel Lebanon strikes (Reuters Apr 8). US-Israel still targeting nuclear expertise. Ceasefire fragile but holding despite Hormuz re-closure. Diplomatic: MEDIUM (down from HIGH). Technical: CRITICAL unchanged. Probability DOWN to 32%. Falling.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 50. DETERIORATING: Hormuz status UNCLEAR despite ceasefire deal. Iran re-closed strait after Israel Lebanon strikes (Reuters/AP Apr 8). VP Vance says 'signs strait starting to reopen' but shippers demand clarity. Iran FM says peace talks 'unreasonable'. FDD confirms 2-week ceasefire. Gulf nations may strike Iran directly (JINSA). Oil crisis deepening. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: LOW. Probability UP to 42%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 50. VOLATILE: Massive Israeli strikes - 50 jets, 160 bombs, largest wave since Mar 1 (LA Times). Netanyahu says ceasefire does NOT cover Lebanon. 1,500+ killed, 1M displaced. BUT: Netanyahu authorizes direct talks with Lebanon (Reuters/AP Apr 9/10). Hezbollah paused attacks under US-Iran ceasefire. Lebanese official: 'no negotiations under fire.' Diplomatic opening slightly lowers probability. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: MEDIUM. Probability DOWN to 60%. Falling.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: ESCALATING: Turkey unveils plan to build 8 nuclear reactors (Middle East Monitor Mar 19). FM Fidan: Iran ambitions could push Turkey into nuclear arms race. OSW confirms strategic ambiguity. Roketsan 300ER missile test planned 2026. Akkuyu commissioning. Nuclear infrastructure expanding rapidly. Technical: HIGH (up from medium). Probability UP to 13%. Rising.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: MIXED: Pakistan hailed as peacemaker for mediating Iran ceasefire (Bloomberg Apr 9). India looks on 'warily.' Pakistan FM rejects US ICBM claims. PFBR milestone raises Pakistan concerns. US Threat Assessment: 'remain at risk of nuclear conflict.' No new military escalation. Diplomatic: MEDIUM. Probability DOWN slightly to 24%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 50. STRATEGIC WINDFALL: Iran war diverting Western attention. Oil surging, sanctions easing billions into Russia. Nuclear false flag concerns (Euronews). RealClearDefense: doctrine changes for sphere of influence. GLOBSEC: hybrid warfare escalation 2026. New START expired Feb 2026. Probability stable at 57%.

china.name: China
china.notes: ESCALATING: China drills for US nuclear attack in Taiwan war (Asia Times). $222B on Eastern PLA forces. KMT Chairwoman Beijing visit. Jin Canrong suggests boarding weapons ships. Taiwan budget delay threatens $2.4B weapons (Reuters). CNN: expanding nuclear weapons infrastructure. Technical: CRITICAL. Mobilization: HIGH. Probability UP to 18%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 50. SUSTAINED TESTING: cluster-bomb warhead missiles (NPR Apr 9). 10 ballistic missiles from Sunan (Mar 16). Cruise missile tests from destroyer. Kim re-elected Supreme Leader. RARE SOFT SIGNAL: Kim complimented SK President Lee (CNN Apr 7). Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. ICBM, tactical nukes, LACMs deployed. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Technical: CRITICAL. Probability 88%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1141+. Nuclear false flag concerns (Euronews). Russia changing nuclear doctrine (RealClearDefense). Doomsday Clock: nuclear risk 3rd year. Iran war diverting Western attention. GCRI analysis published. New START expired. GLOBSEC: hybrid warfare escalation. Probability UP to 81%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: ESCALATING: Fighting resumed after Eid ceasefire (WaPo Mar 25). 2 killed, 8 wounded in Kunar. Urumqi talks continue (Al Jazeera Apr 2) but mortar incidents persist. Pakistan campaign 'here to stay' (The Diplomat). UN urges ceasefire. Pakistan mediating Iran ceasefire simultaneously. Mobilization: HIGH. Diplomatic: MEDIUM. Probability UP to 10%. Rising.
